# incusos_application (Resource)

Manages an IncusOS application (`/1.0/applications/{name}`), such as `gpu-support`, `debug`, `incus`, `migration-manager`, or `operations-center`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name (e.g., `gpu-support`, `debug`, `incus`).

### Optional

- `pin_current_versions` (Boolean) When true, prevent newer versions of this application from being downloaded.

### Read-Only

- `available_versions` (List of String) List of locally available versions for this application.
- `friendly_version` (String) Human-readable application version string.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `initialized` (Boolean) Whether the application has been initialized.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary application on the IncusOS host.
- `version` (String) Installed application version identifier.
